geopolitique.title: Measuring Geopolitical Risk
geopolitique.abstract: We present a news-based measure of adverse geopolitical events and associated risks. The geopolitical risk (GPR) index spikes around the two world wars, at the beginning of the Korean War, during the Cuban Missile Crisis, and after 9/11. Higher geopolitical risk foreshadows lower investment and employment and is associated with higher disaster probability and larger downside risks.

geopolitique.title: COVID-19 pandemic, oil prices, stock market, geopolitical risk and policy uncertainty nexus in the US economy: Fresh evidence from the wavelet-based approach
geopolitique.authors: Arshian Sharif, Chaker Aloui, Larisa Yarovaya

geopolitique.title: The Geopolitics of Knowledge and the Colonial Difference
geopolitique.abstract: The South Atlantic Quarterly - Volume 101, Number 1, Winter 2002

geopolitique.title: Research on the Impact of Geopolitical Instability on Russian Trade
geopolitique.venue: International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology (IJISRT)
geopolitique.abstract: This study examines how global and country- specific geopolitical instability affects Russian trade using data from 1996 to 2021. A panel regression model analyzes trade between Russia and its 15 top trading partners, exploring both direct and indirect effects. The analysis focuses on how accumulated foreign direct investment (FDI) and exchange rate fluctuations mediate these relationships.

geopolitique.title: Secure the volume: Vertical geopolitics and the depth of power
Geopolitical disruptions in global supply chains: a state-of-the-art literature review
geopolitique.authors: Lukasz Bednarski, Samuel Roscoe, Constantin Blome et al.
geopolitique.abstract: This paper systematically reviews the literature on the impact of geopolitical disruptions on supply chains to identify primary discourses, emergent themes and key gaps to set a future research agenda. The guiding research question is ‘how do geopolitical disruptions affect the configuration, flow, and management of global supply chains?’.

geopolitique.title: Revisiting the Environmental Kuznets Curve (EKC) Hypothesis of Carbon Emissions: Exploring the Impact of Geopolitical Risks, Natural Resource Rents, Corrupt Governance, and Energy Intensity
geopolitique.authors: Rongrong Li, Qiang Wang, Jiale Guo

geopolitique.title: Digital capabilities to manage agri-food supply chain uncertainties and build supply chain resilience during compounding geopolitical disruptions
geopolitique.authors: Amine Belhadi, Sachin Kamble, Nachiappan Subramanian et al.
geopolitique.venue: International Journal of Operations & Production Management
geopolitique.abstract: Purpose The agricultural supply chain is susceptible to disruptive geopolitical events. Therefore, agri-food firms must devise robust resilience strategies to hasten recovery and mitigate global food security effects. Hence, the central aim of this paper is to investigate how supply chains could leverage digital technologies to design resilience strategies to manage uncertainty stemming from the external environment…

geopolitique.title: Strategy towards sustainable energy transition: The effect of environmental governance, economic complexity and geopolitics
geopolitique.authors: Satar Bakhsh, Wei David Zhang, Kishwar Ali et al.
geopolitique.abstract: The Paris Agreement and COP27 have been actively working towards a transition to clean energy (SDG-7) and the restoration of the green environment (SDG-13). Therefore, this study was situated within a comprehensive policy framework. This study aims to investigate the effects of environmental governance and economic complexity on energy transition in 20 OECD countries selected for analysis from 1990 to 2021.

geopolitique.title: Géopolitique de la connaissance, colonialité du pouvoir et différence coloniale
geopolitique.abstract: Résumé Le marché des produits kasher connaît depuis quelques années un développement contre-intuitif. Divers rapports d’étude, présentant la certification comme une « martingale », invitent les professionnels de l’agroalimentaire à rapidement labelliser leur offre commerciale. La pertinence de cette recommandation est ici testée.

geopolitique.title: Géopolitique de la sensibilité et du savoir. (Dé)colonialité, pensée frontalière et désobéissance épistémologique
geopolitique.abstract: À la différence de la démarche postcoloniale issue du monde anglophone, la pensée décoloniale est originaire du tiers monde, dans la diversité de ses histoires locales et de ses époques. Elle met en évidence la dimension raciste et culturellement infériorisante de la domination coloniale et s’ouvre à des modes de vie et de pensée disqualifiés depuis le début de la modernité capitaliste/ coloniale.

geopolitique.title: L'aménagement, une question géopolitique !
geopolitique.abstract: La multiplication des conflits de tous types autour des projets et des politiques d’aménagement (défense d’entreprises ou d’équipements menacés de restructuration, concurrence entre territoires, mobilisation de riverains (nimby) ou d’écologistes) conduit à considérer l’aménagement du territoire non plus seulement comme une affaire de spécialistes, une affaire de bon diagnostic et d’opérations bien pensées, mais…

geopolitique.title: Changement climatique : Dynamiques scientifiques, expertise, enjeux géopolitiques
geopolitique.abstract: En moins de trente ans, le changement climatique d’origine anthropique est devenu un enjeu, tant scientifique que géopolitique, majeur, concernant un nombre croissant de communautés de recherche, de partenaires et d’acteurs politiques. Une instance intergouvernementale d’expertise très singulière – le Groupe Intergouvernemental d’Etude du Climat (GIEC) – a joué un rôle déterminant dans la reconfiguration du champ et…

geopolitique.title: De l’intérêt de questionner l’histoire et le contexte géopolitique tchétchène en consultation orthophonique
geopolitique.abstract: L’orthophonie, à la croisée de disciplines diverses, se tient aussi à la croisée de différentes rencontres, marquées pour certaines par un parcours migratoire complexe. Et si penser une orthophonie plus transculturelle commençait par un pas de décentrage pour explorer d’autres voies complémentaristes ?

geopolitique.title: Changement climatique et tensions géopolitiques : l'exemple de l'eau. Introduction
Géopolitique de la mémorisation du Coran : une ethnographie dans le sud marocain
geopolitique.abstract: À la suite des attentats du 11 septembre 2001 aux États-Unis, une contestation s’est déchaînée contre les madrasas, ces institutions religieuses chargées de l’enseignement du Coran. Elles ont été accusées par les élites politiques, les médias occidentaux et une partie du monde musulman d’être des foyers de radicalisation.

geopolitique.title: Le savant et la géopolitique
geopolitique.abstract: Lorsqu’on la fait sortir par la porte du laboratoire, la géopolitique rentre parfois par la fenêtre. Récemment, les organisateurs d’un événement scientifique international ont été confrontés à l’impossibilité d’ignorer les réalités politiques, quand bien même ils tenteraient de maintenir leurs activités à l’écart.

politique.title: An Economic Theory of Democracy.
politique.authors: Edward C. Banfield, Anthony J. Downs
politique.abstract: Downs presents a rational calculus of voting that has inspired much of the later work on voting and turnout. Particularly significant was his conclusion that a rational voter should almost never bother to vote. This conclusion, especially as elaborated on by Riker and Ordeshook (1968) has shifted the attention of modern political scientists from explaining why people don't vote to explaining why they do.

politique.title: Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy
politique.abstract: Introduction. Part I: The Marxian Doctrine. Prologue. I. Marx the Prophet. II. Marx the Sociologist. III. Marx the Economist. IV Marx the Teacher. Part II: Can Capitalism Survive? Prologue. V. The Rate of Increase of Total Output. VI. Plausible Capitalism. VII. The Process of Creative Destruction. VIII. Monopolistics Practices. IX. Closed Season. X. The Vanishing of Investment Opportunity. XI.

politique.title: Making Democracy Work: Civic Traditions in Modern Italy
Some Social Requisites of Democracy: Economic Development and Political Legitimacy
politique.abstract: The conditions associated with the existence and stability of democratic society have been a leading concern of political philosophy. In this paper the problem is attacked from a sociological and behavioral standpoint, by presenting a number of hypotheses concerning some social requisites for democracy, and by discussing some of the data available to test these hypotheses.

politique.title: Democracy and Education.
politique.authors: Ernest Carroll Moore, JOHN M. DEWEY
politique.venue: The Journal of Philosophy Psychology and Scientific Methods

politique.title: Transitions to Democracy and Democratic Consolidation: Theoretical and Comparative Issues
politique.abstract: Abstract In the 1980s, an extensive literature has emerged on transitions to democracy and democratic processes in Latin America. Latin Americans and Latin Americanists have produced ground breaking works that have enhanced understanding of these subjects. A number of differences of opinion, usually implicit and not articulated, have arisen.

politique.title: AI-Powered Election Insights: Predicting the 2024 Trump vs. Kamala Election Showdown with Machine Learning
politique.authors: Yazan Yazan, Mohammad Alsharo, Malik AL AL-Essa et al.
politique.venue: Journal of Intelligent Systems and Internet of Things
politique.abstract: The United States presidential elections receive a substantial attention not only from American voters, but also from news agencies, politicians, and international governments due to the local and global impact of the outcome. Therefore, different parties strive to predict the election’s results ahead of time, and opinion polls remain the predominant prediction method despite their bias and flaws.

politique.title: Economic insecurity and the demand for populism in Europe
politique.authors: Luigi Guiso, Helios Herrera, Massimo Morelli et al.
politique.abstract: We document the spiral of populism in Europe and the direct and indirect role of economic insecurity shocks. Using survey data on individual voting, we make two contributions to the literature. (i) Economic insecurity shocks have a significant impact on the populist vote share, directly as demand for protection, and indirectly through the induced changes in trust and attitudes.

politique.title: Planning beyond growth: The case for economic democracy within ecological limits
politique.authors: Cédric Durand, Elena Hofferberth, Matthias Schmelzer
politique.abstract: Degrowth and post-growth economics has rejuvenated the debates about the reorientation of economies in the Global North towards environmental sustainability, equality, need satisfaction and democracy. This perspective promotes a planned reduction of energy and resource use in the global North to limit environmental pressures and global inequalities and improving well-being.

politique.title: The Russian threat and the consolidation of the West: How populism and EU-skepticism shape party support for Ukraine
politique.authors: Liesbet Hooghe, Gary Wolfe Marks, Ryan Bakker et al.
politique.abstract: Support for Ukraine against Russian aggression has been strong across Europe, but it is far from uniform. An expert survey of the positions taken by political parties in 29 countries conducted mid-2023 reveals that 97 of 269 parties reject one or more of the following: providing weapons, hosting refugees, supporting Ukraine's path to European Union membership, or accepting higher energy costs.

politique.title: Un bilan des recherches sur la participation du public en démocratie : beaucoup de bruit pour rien ?
politique.abstract: Résumé La foisonnante littérature sur la participation donne au premier regard une impression d’éclatement. Il est possible cependant de dégager de cet état des savoirs sur la participation du public en démocratie, quelques postures partagées et une série de questions transversales, autour desquelles un débat scientifique peut se nouer.

politique.title: La démocratie Internet
politique.abstract: Résumé Dans un entretien accordé à la revue Transversalités , le sociologue Dominique Cardon met en évidence la révolution démocratique qu’a constituée l’émergence d’Internet. Internet aurait ainsi permis un élargissement de l’espace public et un déplacement de la frontière entre représentants et représentés par les propositions qu’il fait : délibération élargie, auto-organisation, mise en place de collectifs…

politique.title: La démocratie sexuelle et le conflit des civilisations
politique.abstract: Résumé Dans le monde postcolonial, et plus particulièrement depuis le 11 septembre 2001, une norme libérale occidentale renouvelée ajoute aux droits de l’homme la « démocratie sexuelle » (une conception lisse de la féminité à laquelle tend à s’adjoindre une conception lisse de l’homosexualité).

politique.title: Repenser la sphère publique : une contribution à la critique de la démocratie telle qu'elle existe réellement
politique.abstract: Notre texte est davantage un épilogue qu’une conclusion. Tout en invitant à poursuivre une analyse critique des stéréotypes de l’Autre, il rappelle le rôle essentiel de la doxa et de ses représentations stéréotypées, y compris dans le discours scientifique.

politique.title: Intégrer la démocratie en santé à la préparation et à la conduite des situations sanitaires exceptionnelles : obstacles et leviers opérationnels
politique.authors: Alecia Oger, Jean-Marc Philippe, Marick Fèvre
politique.abstract: Trust in French health institutions has eroded over successive exceptional health situations (EHS), the COVID-19 pandemic having revealed preexisting tensions. France nonetheless has a dense health democracy architecture (National Health Conference, regional health and autonomy conferences, territorial health councils, users’ committees), which remains largely disconnected from EHS preparedness and response (ORSAN…

La délégitimation des élections et du juge électoral dans le contexte des ingérences étrangères
La démocratie sociale, déclinaison de la démocratie politique en entreprise ?

economie.title: Economic Action and Social Structure: The Problem of Embeddedness
economie.abstract: How behavior and institutions are affected by social relations is one of the classic questions of social theory. This paper concerns the extent to which economic action is embedded in structures of social relations, in modern industrial society. Although the usual neoclasical accounts provide an undersocialized or atomized-actor explanation of such action, reformist economists who attempt to bring social structure…

economie.title: Institutions, Institutional Change and Economic Performance
economie.authors: Michael C. Munger, Douglass C. North
economie.abstract: Examines the role that institutions, defined as the humanly devised constraints that shape human interaction, play in economic performance and how those institutions change and how a model of dynamic institutions explains the differential performance of economies through time.

Running out of raw material stock results in delays in production activities, while excess raw material stock can fill warehouse capacity, thereby increasing storage…

economie.title: Economic growth and income inequality
economie.venue: International Journal of Public Administration Management and Economic Development
economie.abstract: In recent years the problem of economic inequalities has become one of the most often discussed problems in economics. Even though from neoclassical perspective inequalities should not have negative impact on economy, still the relation between inequalities and economic growth is not obvious.

economie.title: Candidate of Economic Sciences
economie.abstract: Рассмотрено ведение лесного хозяйства в Италии. Состояние лесов страны представлено в разрезе регионов по показателям общей площади, лесистости, запасам древесины, породному составу и доступности лесов для заготовки древесины. Проанализированы типы охраняемых лесных территорий и распределение их площади по регионам. Рассмотрена структура собственников лесных участков.

economie.title: Critically assessing sodium-ion technology roadmaps and scenarios for techno-economic competitiveness against lithium-ion batteries
economie.authors: Adrian Yao, Sally M. Benson, William C. Chueh
economie.abstract: Sodium-ion batteries are considered a promising substitute for Li-ion, but the timeline and conditions for achieving cost-competitiveness remain uncertain. This study evaluates their techno-economic potential, showing that while challenging, they could compete with low-cost Li-ion batteries by the 2030s under specific conditions.

economie.title: RETRACTED ARTICLE: The economic commitment of climate change
economie.authors: Maximilian Kotz, Anders Levermann, Leonie Wenz
economie.abstract: Abstract 8 December 2025. The published version of this preprint was retracted from *Nature* in December 2025. The retraction notice can be found [here](https://doi.org/10.1186/s40337-022-00716-5). Research Square has withdrawn this preprint.

economie.title: Socio-économie de proximité
economie.abstract: En 1993, le numéro spécial de la Revue d’Economie Régionale et Urbaine consacré aux économies de proximité fondait une approche originale de la dimension spatiale des phénomènes économiques, et donnait une première expression aux travaux du groupe « Dynamiques de proximité », dont le postulat de base consiste à dissocier la proximité dans l’espace physique d’autres formes de proximité, d’essence non spatiale.

economie.title: Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques (INSEE)
Les marchés économiques comme dispositifs collectifs de calcul
economie.abstract: Comment aborder empiriquement le caractère calculateur des marchés sans pour autant le dissoudre ? Dans cet article, les auteurs proposent un cadre théorique qui permette d’analyser des marchés sans négliger ses propriétés calculatrices concrètes. Dans une première section, ils construisent une définition large de « calcul », basée sur les enseignements de la sociologie des sciences et des techniques.

economie.title: Le champ économique
economie.venue: Actes de la recherche en sciences sociales
economie.abstract: Le champ économique. En se fondant sur les recherches menées au sujet de l'économie de la maison individuelle, il s'agit de construire une théorie économique plus respectueuse de la logique pratique des agents, intégrant les conditions économiques et sociales de la genèse des dispositions économiques.

economie.title: Human climate niche, habitability range, and economic growth
economie.authors: Jean-François Gajewski, Paul-Oliver Klein, Fatima Ezzahrae Tahri
economie.abstract: This study develops a contemporaneous measure of the human habitability of geographic areas, the Habitability Range that builds upon the work of Xu et al. ( 2020) on pretechnological human density in a temperatureprecipitation climatic space. Using this measure with climatic data from 1901 to 2022, we document a 32.98% (-8.40 pp) global decline in human habitability over the past century.

finance.authors: Stewart C. Myers, Nicholas S. Majluf

finance.title: Law and Finance
finance.authors: Rafael La Porta, Florencio López‐de‐Silanes, Andrei Shleifer et al.
finance.abstract: This paper examines legal rules covering protection of corporate shareholders and creditors, the origin of these rules, and the quality of their enforcement in 49 countries. The results show that common‐law countries generally have the strongest, and frenchcivillaw countries the weakest, legal protections of investors, with German‐and scandinavin‐civil‐law countries located in the middle.

finance.title: Agency Costs of Free Cash Flow, Corporate Finance, and Takeovers
finance.abstract: The interests and incentives of managers and shareholders conflict over such issues as the optimal size of the firm and the payment of cash to shareholders. These conflicts are especially severe in firms with large free cash flows—more cash than profitable investment opportunities.

finance.title: The Cost of Capital, Corporation Finance and the Theory of Investment
finance.abstract: The potential advantages of the market-value approach have long been appreciated; yet analytical results have been meager. What appears to be keeping this line of development from achieving its promise is largely the lack of an adequate theory of the effect of financial structure on market valuations, and of how these effects can be inferred from objective market data.

finance.title: Estimating Standard Errors in Finance Panel Data Sets: Comparing Approaches
finance.abstract: In corporate finance and asset pricing empirical work, researchers are often confronted with panel data. In these data sets, the residuals may be correlated across firms or across time, and OLS standard errors can be biased. Historically, researchers in the two literatures have used different solutions to this problem.

finance.title: Cyberfraud in the Nigerian Banking Sector: The Techniques and Preventive Measures
finance.venue: International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology (IJISRT)
finance.abstract: The cyberfraud techniques emerged as a significant threat to the banking sector in Nigeria. Bank customers have been losing their hard-earned funds to these measures due to a lack of sufficient awareness of the cyberfraud tactics and preventive measures. There has been an increased rate of loss recorded annually in the banking sector due to fraud.

finance.title: Agent-Based Modeling in Economics and Finance: Past, Present, and Future
finance.authors: Robert L. Axtell, J. Doyne Farmer
finance.abstract: Agent-based modeling (ABM) is a novel computational methodology for representing the behavior of individuals in order to study social phenomena. Its use is rapidly growing in many fields. We review ABM in economics and finance and highlight how it can be used to relax conventional assumptions in standard economic models.

finance.title: Do green finance, green technology innovation, and institutional quality help achieve environmental sustainability? Evidence from the developing economies
finance.authors: Litu Sethi, Biswanath Behera, Narayan Sethi
finance.abstract: Abstract One possible way to achieve sustainable economic growth is by limiting carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) emissions. The developing countries, in particular, which significantly contribute to global carbon dioxide emissions, need a paradigm shift towards sustainable production and consumption to achieve economic growth while ensuring environmental sustainability.

finance.title: Artificial intelligence in Finance: a comprehensive review through bibliometric and content analysis
finance.authors: Salman Bahoo, Marco Cucculelli, Xhoana Goga et al.
finance.abstract: Abstract Over the past two decades, artificial intelligence (AI) has experienced rapid development and is being used in a wide range of sectors and activities, including finance. In the meantime, a growing and heterogeneous strand of literature has explored the use of AI in finance.

finance.title: Empowering energy transition: Green innovation, digital finance, and the path to sustainable prosperity through green finance initiatives
finance.authors: Mohammad Razib Hossain, Amar Rao, Gagan Deep Sharma et al.
finance.abstract: This study delves into the intricate relationship between financial digitization and green innovation, aiming to shed light on their dynamic interplay within a global context. Spanning from 2003 to 2020, the study encompasses 15 diverse countries, encompassing both developed and emerging economies, including Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Russian Federation, South…

finance.title: La science en projets : financements sur projet, autonomie professionnelle et transformations du travail des chercheurs académiques
finance.abstract: Cet article s’inscrit dans les débats sur les transformations du travail des « professionnels » face à l’émergence de nouvelles formes de contrôle et de régulation de leurs activités. En s’appuyant sur une enquête empirique sur la recherche en électronique et micro/nanotechnologies, il s’interroge sur les évolutions du travail des chercheurs académiques face à l’essor des politiques de financement sur projet.

finance.title: Public and Private Capital’s Role in Advancing Green Finance Investment: Evidence from a Structural–behavioural Model of Capital Mobilisation in the UK
finance.authors: Mahua Biswas, Noor Mukhtar, Aparajita Guria
finance.venue: Journal of Scientific Research and Reports
finance.abstract: Achieving net-zero targets requires the mobilisation of private capital alongside credible public policy support. This study examines how government support mechanisms shape green investment commitment among UK financial professionals through an integrated structural–behavioural model.

finance.title: Mapping the Intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Sustainable Finance: A TCCM-Driven Bibliometric Analysis and Conceptual Framework
finance.authors: Douae Youbi, Abdessamad Ouchen, El Mehdi Steli
finance.venue: Journal of Risk and Financial Management
finance.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) and sustainable finance are increasingly intersecting, yet re search at their intersection remains fragmented and theoretically underdeveloped. This study combines bibliometric analysis with the Theory–Context–Characteristics–Method ology (TCCM) framework to examine 61 PRISMA-screened articles retrieved from Web of Science.

finance.title: Markets, Money and Agency: A Critical Narrative Review of Marketing Systems, Access to Finance and the Empowerment of Women Shea Butter Processors in West Africa
finance.venue: Journal of Scientific Research and Reports
finance.abstract: The shea tree (Vitellaria paradoxa C. F. Gaertn.) underpins one of the few rural West African economies in which women dominate collection, processing and trade. Rising international demand for shea kernels and butter from the confectionery and cosmetics industries has encouraged governments, donors and firms to present shea as a pathway to women's economic empowerment.

finance.title: Multidimensional Crisis of the Intermunicipal System of Drinking Water and Sewerage Services (SIAPA) in the Guadalajara Metropolitan Area: A Documentary Analysis of Water Security, Finance, Social Equity and Public Health
finance.authors: Ramirez-Sanchez Hermes Ulises, Garcia-Guadalupe Mario Enrique, Fajardo-Montiel Aida-Lucia et al.
finance.venue: Journal of Geography, Environment and Earth Science International
finance.abstract: The Intermunicipal System of Drinking Water and Sewerage Services (SIAPA) in the Guadalajara Metropolitan Area (GMA) faces a multidimensional water-security challenge involving source availability and quality, infrastructure condition, operational efficiency, financial stress, unequal service impacts and public-health protection.

sport.title: Progressive Statistics for Studies in Sports Medicine and Exercise Science
sport.authors: Will G. Hopkins, Stephen W. Marshall, Alan M. Batterham et al.
sport.abstract: Statistical guidelines and expert statements are now available to assist in the analysis and reporting of studies in some biomedical disciplines. We present here a more progressive resource for sample-based studies, meta-analyses, and case studies in sports medicine and exercise science.

Pourtant, certaines recherches récentes en histoire de l’art numérique mobilisent des méthodes issues de la vision par ordinateur qui tendent à réactiver un formalisme largement décrié par de telles critiques et…

art.title: Enseigner la transition aux artistes et designers de demain
art.abstract: Valérie Michel-Fauré a participé à l’école d’été « Musées en transition » fin mai 2024 à l’université de Toulon, au sein de l’Institut méditerranéen des sciences de l’information et de la communication (Imsic), dans les locaux de l’UFR Ingémédia, financée par la Fondation Samuel de Champlain et le Conseil de développement de Toulon Provence Méditerranée (TPM).

musique.title: A Generative Theory of Tonal Music
musique.authors: Peter Child, Fred Lerdahl, Ray S. Jackendoff
musique.abstract: This book explores the relationships between language, music, and the brain by pursuing four key themes and the crosstalk among them: song and dance as a bridge between music and language; multiple levels of structure from brain to behavior to culture; the semantics of internal and external worlds and the role of emotion; and the evolution and development of language.

musique.title: MUSIC, maximum likelihood, and Cramer-Rao bound
musique.venue: IEEE Transactions on Acoustics Speech and Signal Processing
musique.abstract: The performance of the MUSIC and ML methods is studied, and their statistical efficiency is analyzed. The Cramer-Rao bound (CRB) for the estimation problems is derived, and some useful properties of the CRB covariance matrix are established. The relationship between the MUSIC and ML estimators is investigated as well.

musique.title: Intensely pleasurable responses to music correlate with activity in brain regions implicated in reward and emotion
musique.authors: Anne J. Blood, Robert J. Zatorre
musique.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
musique.abstract: We used positron emission tomography to study neural mechanisms underlying intensely pleasant emotional responses to music. Cerebral blood flow changes were measured in response to subject-selected music that elicited the highly pleasurable experience of "shivers-down-the-spine" or "chills." Subjective reports of chills were accompanied by changes in heart rate, electromyogram, and respiration.

musique.title: Musical genre classification of audio signals
musique.venue: IEEE Transactions on Speech and Audio Processing
musique.abstract: Musical genres are categorical labels created by humans to characterize pieces of music. A musical genre is characterized by the common characteristics shared by its members. These characteristics typically are related to the instrumentation, rhythmic structure, and harmonic content of the music. Genre hierarchies are commonly used to structure the large collections of music available on the Web.

musique.title: YIN, a fundamental frequency estimator for speech and music
musique.authors: Alain De Cheveigné A, Hideki Kawahara
musique.venue: The Journal of the Acoustical Society of America
musique.abstract: An algorithm is presented for the estimation of the fundamental frequency (F0) of speech or musical sounds. It is based on the well-known autocorrelation method with a number of modifications that combine to prevent errors. The algorithm has several desirable features.

musique.title: Quality Control to Reduce Appearance Defects at PT. Musical Instrument
musique.authors: Dikka Safriyanto, Fibi Eko Putra, Putri Anggun Sari
musique.venue: International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology (IJISRT)
musique.abstract: This research was conducted at PT. Musical Instruments that aim to analyze quality control to reduce appearance defects in piano products on the assembling production line. The problem faced by the company is the high level of product defects which has an impact on decreasing quality and customer satisfaction. The research method used is Six sigma with a DMAIC (Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control) approach.

musique.title: Content-driven music recommendation: Evolution, state of the art, and challenges
musique.authors: Yashar Deldjoo, Markus Schedl, Peter Knees

musique.title: AI-Based Affective Music Generation Systems: A Review of Methods and Challenges
musique.abstract: Music is a powerful medium for altering the emotional state of the listener. In recent years, with significant advancements in computing capabilities, artificial intelligence-based (AI-based) approaches have become popular for creating affective music generation (AMG) systems.

musique.title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Music Education: A Critical Synthesis of Challenges and Opportunities
musique.authors: Javier Félix Merchán Sánchez-Jara, Sara González Gutiérrez, Javier Cruz Rodríguez et al.
musique.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is a hot topic that presents new challenges and opportunities for the improvement of educational processes. The disruptive and transformative force of this new technological development implies the adaptation of educational ecosystems for its use and integration as a didactic and pedagogical resource.

musique.title: Commonality and variation in mental representations of music revealed by a cross-cultural comparison of rhythm priors in 15 countries
musique.authors: Nori Jacoby, Rainer Polak, Jessica Adrienne Grahn et al.
musique.abstract: Music is present in every known society but varies from place to place. What, if anything, is universal to music cognition? We measured a signature of mental representations of rhythm in 39 participant groups in 15 countries, spanning urban societies and Indigenous populations.

musique.title: Dissociations entre musique et langage après atteinte cérébrale: Un nouveau cas d'amusie sans aphasie.
musique.authors: Isabelle Peretz, Sylvie Belleville, Sophie Fontaine
musique.venue: Canadian Journal of Experimental Psychology/Revue canadienne de psychologie expérimentale
musique.abstract: We present the neuropsychological study of a patient, I.R., who sustained bilateral damage to the temporal lobes and to the right frontal lobe as a result of successive brain surgeries that occurred ten years earlier. The patient is 40 years old and right-handed; she had no special training in music or in language, representing, therefore, the large majority of listeners.

musique.title: Professionnalisation féminine et féminisation d'une profession : les artistes interprètes de musique
musique.abstract: Résumé A l’égal d’autres professions qualifiées, l’accès des femmes à la pratique musicale comme professionnelle est récent et inachevé. En tant qu’artistes interprètes, en particulier comme instrumentistes, les musiciennes ont trouvé place dans les orchestres symphoniques permanents au cours de la seconde moitié du xx e siècle, sans toutefois investir tous les postes et tous les rôles : la division du travail reste…

musique.title: Deux exemples de presse musicale jeune en France, de 1966 à 1969 : Salut Les Copains et Rock & Folk
musique.abstract: à l’heure où la mode hippie explose en France, en 1966, s’affrontent dans la presse musicale dédiée aux jeunes deux points de vue opposés. D’un côté, la légitimité historique de Salut Les Copains, journal créé en 1962 par deux anciens de l’émission d’Europe 1 « Pour ceux qui aiment le jazz », Daniel Filipacchi et Frank Ténot.

musique.title: Lettre ouverte sur les musiques « noires », « afro-américaines » et « européennes »
musique.abstract: La première et, jusqu’ici seule version de ce texte, qui date du 4 mai 1987, est en anglais et a été envoyée à certains collègues chercheurs en musique populaire, afin d’être commentée. Le texte a été réédité le 14 juin 1987 et envoyé à la revue Popular Music (Cambridge University Press) qui l’a publié dans son volume 8/3 (1989 : 285-298) dans la section « Debate ».

musique.title: « A critical duet » : les échanges épistolaires de Vernon Lee et Irene Forbes-Mosse autour de la musique »
musique.abstract: Cette étude se consacre aux échanges épistolaires entre Vernon Lee et Irene Forbes-Mosse, écrivaine allemande, fixée, comme Lee, en Italie, à Florence. Les deux femmes y font connaissance vers 1900. Il s’agit de deux personnalités à la notoriété fort inégale – l’une cherchant à cette époque à s’initier au métier de l’écriture, l’autre établie depuis longtemps comme écrivaine et essayiste.

musique.title: Prévalence et caractérisation des troubles physiques gênant la pratique musicale chez les instrumentistes à vent : une étude observationnelle
musique.authors: Mathieu Aeby, Julie Hervé-Colas, Claudio Agueci et al.
musique.abstract: Introduction : Les instrumentistes à vent sont exposé·es à des contraintes mécaniques, respiratoires et oro-faciales spécifiques, susceptibles de générer des problèmes physiques gênant la pratique musicale (PPGPM). Or, très peu d’études ont été menées pour ces musicien·nes, ce qui limite la compréhension du contexte et les possibilités de mettre en place des mesures préventives adaptées.

musique.title: Inextricables confluences entre Orient et Occident : La pensée musicale péripatéticienne gréco-arabe
musique.abstract: Il serait difficile de ne pas puiser dans la confluence des musiques et théories comparées, depuis toujours, entre arts et savoirs, Orient et Occident, pour ne pas se retrouver devant des éléments véhiculaires de musique (s) autant que de musicothérapie (s) empreintes d’embrouillamini.

musique.title: Musique et danse du Tiers État
musique.abstract: Le ballet Flamme de Paris (Пламя Парижа), sur une musique de Boris Assafiev, est représenté à Leningrad en 1932, pour célébrer les quinze ans de la révolution d’Octobre. Il traite dans son contenu de la « Grande Révolution française » et appartient dans sa forme au genre du ballet soviétique, le drambalet, et par suite à l’esthétique du réalisme socialiste.

mode.title: Humans integrate visual and haptic information in a statistically optimal fashion
mode.authors: Marc O. Ernst, Martin S. Banks

mode.title: Do social media marketing activities enhance customer equity? An empirical study of luxury fashion brand
Managerial Fads and Fashions: The Diffusion and Rejection of Innovations
mode.abstract: Reviews indicate that the dominant perspective in the diffusion of innovation literature contains proinnovation biases which suggest that innovations and the diffusion of innovations will benefit adopters. As a result, it is difficult to either address or begin answering the questions: when and how do technically inefficient innovations diffuse? or when and how are technically efficient innovations rejected?

mode.title: Mitosis-specific phosphorylation of histone H3 initiates primarily within pericentromeric heterochromatin during G2 and spreads in an ordered fashion coincident with mitotic chromosome condensation
mode.authors: Michael J. Hendzel, Yi Wei, Michael A. Mancini et al.

mode.title: A Theory of Fads, Fashion, Custom, and Cultural Change as Informational Cascades
mode.authors: Sushil Bikhchandani, David A. Hirshleifer, Ivo Welch
mode.abstract: An informational cascade occurs when it is optimal for an individual, having observed the actions of those ahead of him, to follow the behavior of the preceding individual without regard to his own information. We argue that localized conformity of behavior and the fragility of mass behaviors can be explained by informational cascades.

mode.title: Sustainable Fashion: Exploring the Concept of Greenwashing and New Trends in the Fashion Industry
mode.venue: International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology (IJISRT)
mode.abstract: The fashion industry, characterized by rapid cycles of production and consumption, has emerged as a global economic powerhouse, generating significant revenue and employment opportunities worldwide. However, this growth has come at a substantial environmental and social cost, marked by extensive resource consumption, greenhouse gas emissions, and labor exploitation.

mode.title: Human vs. AI: The battle for authenticity in fashion design and consumer response
mode.venue: Journal of Retailing and Consumer Services

mode.title: The influence of cultural differences on consumers’ willingness to pay more for sustainable fashion
mode.authors: Owais Khan, Nina Varaksina, Andreas Hinterhuber
mode.abstract: Sustainable fashion is imperative to address environmental and social issues associated with the fashion industry. Although it is argued that consumers' willingness to pay more (WTPM) for sustainable products, compared to the price of conventional products, can function as a catalyst to motivate companies to pursue sustainability principles.

mode.title: Azo dye bioremediation: An interdisciplinary path to sustainable fashion
mode.authors: Gajendra Bahadur Singh, Ankita Vinayak, Gaurav Mudgal et al.
mode.abstract: Textile effluents constitute a significant source of environmental contamination due to the substantial discharge of recalcitrant azo dyes. These synthetic xenobiotic compounds, extensively employed across various industries, represent a predominant class of colorants. The persistence of azo dyes in aquatic ecosystems poses a formidable threat to biota, encompassing flora, fauna, and anthropogenic populations.

mode.title: Unlocking the Potential of Artificial Intelligence in Fashion Design and E-Commerce Applications: The Case of Midjourney
mode.venue: Journal of theoretical and applied electronic commerce research
mode.abstract: The fashion industry has shown increasing interest in applying artificial intelligence (AI), yet there is a significant gap in exploring the potential of emerging diffusion-modeling-based AI image-generation systems for fashion design and commerce. Therefore, this study aims to assess the effectiveness of Midjourney, one such AI system, in both fashion design and related commerce applications.

mode.title: Barthes et le vêtement
mode.abstract: Burgelin Olivier. Barthes et le vêtement. In: Communications, 63, 1996. Parcours de Barthes. pp. 81-100.

mode.title: Sur la coupe des vêtements. Variation autour d'un thème de Tchebychev
La carence en vitamine D chez la femme de 18 à 49 ans portant des vêtements couvrants, une réalité méconnue en médecine générale
mode.authors: Sonja Belaid, Ambroise Martin, Anne‐Marie Schott et al.

mode.title: Le vêtement dans les sources juridiques du Bas-Empire
mode.abstract: This article surveys the laws of the Late Empire concerned with textiles, dress and dressing sellers. They relate to the private life (components of patrimony, sale, bequest), confiscations, fiscal supplies (levy and distribution of military uniform), restricting the use of textiles or garments such as those which the emperor alone was permitted to wear (paragauds, silk, purple) or prohibiting the use of barbarian…

mode.title: Du spectacle au texte, du vêtement au costume
mode.abstract: La transmission des tragédies grecques du ve s. av. J.-C. a été assurée par la préservation de leur texte. Une telle modalité remet en question la nature de spectacle de ces œuvres et ce, tout particulièrement au xvie s., lorsqu’elles sont redécouvertes par des érudits s’intéressant avant tout aux aspects philologiques.

mode.title: PDRs4All XXI. Haute Couture: Spectral stitching of JWST MIRI-IFU cubes with matrix completion
mode.authors: Amélie Canin, Cédric Févotte, Nicolas Dobigeon et al.
mode.abstract: MIRI is the imager and spectrograph covering wavelengths from 4.9 to 27.9 µm onboard the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST). The Medium-Resolution Spectrometer (MRS) consists of four integral field units (IFU), each of which has three sub-channels. The twelve resulting spectral data cubes have different fields of view, spatial, and spectral resolutions.

mode.title: Du chic, de l’élégance, du luxe et de l’art" : la haute couture parisienne en spectacle cinématographique par Alex Nalpas et Paul-Louis de Giafferri (1923-1926)
mode.abstract: Issu d’une grande famille bourgeoise disséminée entre Smyrne, Salonique et Marseille, Alex Nalpas est l’un de ces pionniers du commerce des films qui construisent leur carrière au gré des migrations, des rencontres, des opportunités, mais aussi du potentiel spectaculaire associé au médium cinématographique.

mode.title: Vêtement NRBC. Le spectre incarné de l'Apocalypse
